Search your endpoint and mail tools for the file hashes in this report.
Test the YARA rules on a set of clean files first, then use them to hunt for the same file and close variants.
Check network logs for the addresses and domains in the indicators section before deciding they are harmless or harmful: this report does not judge them.

blocks.title: Before you use these rules
blocks.text: The strings were picked by fixed filters (length, not a plain word, not a system path or documentation address) and the rule was checked only against the sample it came from, not against a collection of clean files. Run it over your own clean set before you block on it. Network strings are written with \xNN escapes in the report copies so that no real address is printed; the rule is the same. The download detection.yar holds the same rules with the plain strings.
